description: This file contains the implementation of a Promise class following the Promises/A+ specification, providing asynchronous programming capabilities such as then-composition, cancellation, resolution, rejection, and state management.

classes.name: Promise
classes.description: An implementation of the Promise interface following the Promises/A+ specification, managing asynchronous operations with support for state transitions, callback handling, cancellation, and chaining.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Promise instance with optional wait and cancel functions.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Registers fulfillment and rejection handlers, returning a new promise for chaining.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Registers a rejection handler, alias for then with only rejection callback.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the promise is settled and returns the result or throws an exception if rejected.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise (pending, fulfilled, or rejected).

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the promise, invoking the cancel function if provided.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Fulfills the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a given reason.

methods.name: settle
methods.description: Internal method to transition the promise to fulfilled or rejected, handling handlers and forwarding.

methods.name: callHandler
methods.description: Executes a handler callback, resolving or rejecting the associated promise.

methods.name: waitIfPending
methods.description: Internal method to wait on the promise if it is pending, invoking wait functions as needed.

methods.name: invokeWaitFn
methods.description: Internal method to call the wait function and handle exceptions.

methods.name: invokeWaitList
methods.description: Internal method to wait on all promises in the wait list.
